title: New train: NJ 498 from Wien Hbf to Hamburg Hbf
summary: A new route (17) has been added for train NJ 498, operating daily from Wien Hbf to Hamburg Hbf. The train will stop at Wien Meidling, St. Pölten Hbf, Linz Hbf, Passau Hbf, Regensburg Hbf, Nürnberg Hbf, Würzburg Hbf, Kassel-Wilhelmshöhe, Göttingen, Hannover Hbf, and Hamburg Harburg. The return train is NJ 499.
